notes: Two sayings (rule 11): the request «اقرأ علي» (Ibrahim is the last link) and the «شهيدا عليهم» saying with its own isnad «قال مسعر فحدثني معن ...» ending at Ibn Mas'ud. Both are written; the ruling decides the split.
«- وقال أبو كريب عن مسعر -» is written in dashes, but it is a different route (Abu Kurayb to Mas'ar, without Abu Usama), so it is written as group 2 rather than left out as a gloss.

Groups 1 and 2 share the names «عمرو بن مرة» and «إبراهيم»: the text writes them once after the two routes, so they are written in both. «شك مسعر» is Mas'ar's doubt over the wording and is not a link.
